title: La magia que hay en ti

scenes.title: Late from the Casting
scenes.summary: Arriving late at the restaurant after an audition in the suburbs, Álex's cousin defends short films from the film school while her boss orders her to put on her apron and get to work.

scenes.title: Watching Mariona on Television
scenes.summary: Cleaning up the dining room, the two waitresses turn up a talk show featuring Goya nominee Mariona Terés, and one reassures her teary coworker that her big break will come too.

scenes.title: Opening theme song
scenes.summary: Opening title sequence song following Paquita through the streets of Madrid.

scenes.title: The Magic Within You
scenes.summary: During the annual tarot gathering at PS Management, fortune teller María Rosa Cobo reads the cards for Belinda, reveals that her crush is gay, and shares the message of her book on inner magic.

scenes.title: Alphabetical Order
scenes.summary: María Rosa draws the Sun and Star cards for Belinda's stage career while Paquita organises the crowded waiting room alphabetically, frets over her Goya dress, and hurries Belinda out.

scenes.title: The Cards Never Lie
scenes.summary: Paquita sits down to ask whether Mariona will win the Goya for Best New Actress, and María Rosa draws the Sun and the Star to promise triumph right before Paquita's phone buzzes.

scenes.title: The Tower Card
scenes.summary: In a hurried voice message from a photo shoot, Mariona tells Paquita she is leaving PS Management before the Goyas, and María Rosa draws the Tower card while advising Paquita to let ended relationships go.

scenes.title: What Am I Doing Wrong
scenes.summary: Heartbroken over losing another actress, Paquita asks Magüi what she keeps doing wrong, refuses to watch the showreel of Álex's cousin, and storms home after snapping at her loyal assistant.

scenes.title: Pizza and Piano
scenes.summary: Watching Mariona's television interview in pyjamas at home, Paquita receives a large pizza order from a kind delivery man and discovers him playing gentle piano in her living room so she will not be alone.

scenes.title: Paquita's Piano Ballad
scenes.summary: Musical sequence in which Paquita sings in her pyjamas beside the piano about losing her stars and praying for her bad streak to end, interrupted by the doorbell.

scenes.title: Twenty-Five Years Together
scenes.summary: Lidia stops by in running gear to share personal news while Paquita wallows on the sofa, and reminds Paquita that she has stood by her for twenty-five years because the real Paquita never gives up.

scenes.title: Calling for Lidia and Watching the Reel
scenes.summary: Snapping back into action, Paquita calls a casting director to champion Lidia San José for Puente Viejo, finally watches the moving monologue by Álex's cousin, and apologises to Magüi.

scenes.title: A Gin and Tonic at the Bar
scenes.summary: Visiting the restaurant where Álex's cousin waits tables, Paquita orders her favourite gin and tonic at the bar, asks the young waitress about her acting dreams, and introduces herself as Paquita Salas.

scenes.title: Welcome to PS Management
scenes.summary: Paquita proposes a playful pact to represent the young actress, turn her into a star, and stay friends no matter what, welcoming her to PS Management for a fresh start.

scenes.title: Quitting the Apron
scenes.summary: Laughing as they realise Paquita walked out without paying her tab, the newly signed actress takes off her apron on the spot, quits her restaurant job, and hugs her coworker goodbye.

scenes.title: A Toast to the Future
scenes.summary: Watching the Goya ceremony together at the office, PS Management hears Mariona win Best New Actress and rush back to the microphone to thank Paquita Salas before everyone raises a glass to the future.
